text:
alex: Quick sync thread on compact sidebar regroup + deeplink fidelity. I prototyped behavior where deep links should always land on the exact child, not the parent group.

mira: Repro: go to /ws/beta/models/77/params -> group expands but highlight stays on Models group. users confused.

diego: Root cause: resolver uses longestPrefixMatch before checking exact paramized routes.

alex: Proposal: resolver order exact -> param-resolve -> alias -> longestPrefix. Also normalize hashes and trailing slashes.

zoe: Accessibility: when deep-link opens a child, move DOM focus to that child link and set aria-current="page". If group auto-expands, set aria-expanded="true" on the group button. announce expansion.

mira: UX copy: small inline helper when fallback occurs: "We opened the closest page. View the original link" (dismissible). Only show when resolved !== requested and user can access original.

diego: Dev plan: keep aliasMap in nav manifest (ui repo) + allow runtime patches via feature flag. unit tests for slug collisions.

alex: Also canonicalize using history.replaceState(resolved) and append ?via=orig for debugging. No page reload.

zoe: Keyboard note: focus-land on highlighted item when pressing keyboard shortcut that jumps nav. avoid focus traps. Add unit test for Tab order.

mira: Minimal normalizer pseudocode: "stripHash -> trimTrailingSlash -> lowercaseSegments -> stableSortQueryExcept(auth)"

diego: I'll update the resolver PR and add collision tests.

nav-bot: Preview: https://console-preview.redwood/nav/compact-deeplink (ephemeral)

alex: Action items: @diego PR update, @zoe a11y snippet, @mira mock frames. we'll validate in Thursday design review. Thanks :thumbsup:
